parsed.explanation: The objection identifies a genuine gap. After inserting c, the node labels change, so the rule choosing a disjoint F_D may choose different sets; moreover, no later selected set on that modified branch can contain c. Thus the claimed contraction does not follow. The write-up nowhere else proves finiteness or large-prime erasure for all terms; the summaries merely assert the false finite-transversal conclusion. A replacement lemma establishing the required large-prime-erasure mechanism is needed.
